Mid-Year 2026 Broker Rankings: Special Supplement

 

Sales of commercial real estate properties valued from $5 million to $25 million rose 9.3% to $57.11 billion from January to June, up from $52.25 billion in the first six months of 2026, according to Green Street’s Sales Comps Database. Trades with a sell-side advisor attached rose 23.8%, while unbrokered trades fell 7.8%.
